title: 地理資訊瓦片服務
subcategoryTitle: 神經網路、資料與視覺系統
subcategoryTitleEn: Neural networks, data and visual systems
summary: 以投影、瓦片矩陣與空間服務一致性串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect projections, tile matrices and spatial-service consistency with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

stages.title: 座標與資料
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「座標與資料」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop coordinates and data through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 座標系統：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「座標系統」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for coordinate systems.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「座標系統」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：經緯度與投影平面座標有不同單位與軸序。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「對公開城市代表點記錄 CRS 與軸序。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for coordinate systems. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Longitude/latitude and projected coordinates differ in units and axes. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Record CRS and axis order for public city reference points. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 對公開城市代表點記錄 CRS 與軸序。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Record CRS and axis order for public city reference points. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：兩列數值永遠依經度緯度排列。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Two numbers always mean longitude then latitude. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「座標系統」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「對公開城市代表點記錄 CRS 與軸序。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for coordinate systems; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 經緯度與投影平面座標有不同單位與軸序。
knowledge.textEn: Longitude/latitude and projected coordinates differ in units and axes.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 對公開城市代表點記錄 CRS 與軸序。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Record CRS and axis order for public city reference points. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 常見四叉樹每升一級瓦片數乘 4；z=10 有 4¹⁰=1048576 個全球格。若每格假想 40 kB，完整一級需 41.94 GB 十進位，空海與未覆蓋區域可能不需存。此是特定矩陣模型，不適用所有 CRS。
knowledge.textEn: A common quadtree multiplies tile count by four per zoom; z10 has 1,048,576 global cells. At assumed 40 kB/cell that is 41.94 decimal GB before sparse coverage; the model is specific, not universal to all CRS.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「地理資訊瓦片服務」的「座標系統：原理與架構」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「算力中心：核心不是答案」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Coordinate systems: principles and architecture” in “Geographic-information tile services”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Compute Center: Cores Are Not the Answer” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 審查「座標系統」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for coordinate systems?
options: 兩列數值永遠依經度緯度排列。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「座標系統」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
經緯度與投影平面座標有不同單位與軸序。
optionsEn: Two numbers always mean longitude then latitude.
One matching output proves coordinate systems for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Longitude/latitude and projected coordinates differ in units and axes.
quiz.explanation: 經緯度與投影平面座標有不同單位與軸序。 對公開城市代表點記錄 CRS 與軸序。 因此「兩列數值永遠依經度緯度排列。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Longitude/latitude and projected coordinates differ in units and axes. Record CRS and axis order for public city reference points. The alternative "Two numbers always mean longitude then latitude." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 座標系統：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「座標系統」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for coordinate systems.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「對公開城市代表點記錄 CRS 與軸序。」；將結果與「經緯度與投影平面座標有不同單位與軸序。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Record CRS and axis order for public city reference points. Compare results against: Longitude/latitude and projected coordinates differ in units and axes. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 對公開城市代表點記錄 CRS 與軸序。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Record CRS and axis order for public city reference points. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：兩列數值永遠依經度緯度排列。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Two numbers always mean longitude then latitude. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「座標系統」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「兩列數值永遠依經度緯度排列。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for coordinate systems; explain why this claim fails: Two numbers always mean longitude then latitude.

quiz.question: 審查「座標系統」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for coordinate systems?
options: 對公開城市代表點記錄 CRS 與軸序。
兩列數值永遠依經度緯度排列。
先把「座標系統」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Record CRS and axis order for public city reference points.

steps.title: 投影變形：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「投影變形」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for projection distortion.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「投影變形」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：投影不能同時保留所有面積、角度和距離。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較玩具高低緯度範圍的尺度。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for projection distortion. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: A projection cannot preserve all areas, angles and distances. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare scales across toy low/high latitudes. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較玩具高低緯度範圍的尺度。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare scales across toy low/high latitudes. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：地圖平面每公分永遠代表相同地面距離。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every map centimeter always has equal ground distance. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「投影變形」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較玩具高低緯度範圍的尺度。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for projection distortion; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.text: 投影不能同時保留所有面積、角度和距離。
knowledge.textEn: A projection cannot preserve all areas, angles and distances.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 比較玩具高低緯度範圍的尺度。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。

quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for projection distortion?
options: 地圖平面每公分永遠代表相同地面距離。
投影不能同時保留所有面積、角度和距離。

optionsEn: Every map centimeter always has equal ground distance.
A projection cannot preserve all areas, angles and distances.
One matching output proves projection distortion for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 投影不能同時保留所有面積、角度和距離。 比較玩具高低緯度範圍的尺度。 因此「地圖平面每公分永遠代表相同地面距離。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。

steps.objective: 以「資料範圍」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for data extent.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「資料範圍」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：包圍盒與可用範圍限制可請求資料。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「給自製小地圖示示有效與空白範圍。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

steps.title: 資料範圍：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「資料範圍」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for data extent.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「給自製小地圖示示有效與空白範圍。」；將結果與「包圍盒與可用範圍限制可請求資料。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Mark valid and empty areas on a self-made map. Compare results against: Bounding boxes and available extents limit requests. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 給自製小地圖示示有效與空白範圍。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Mark valid and empty areas on a self-made map. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：全球地圖架構表示每個位置都有資料。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A global map architecture implies data everywhere. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資料範圍」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「全球地圖架構表示每個位置都有資料。」為何不成立。

steps.title: 授權來源：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「授權來源」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for licensed sources.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「授權來源」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：瓦片展示與離線大量儲存可能需不同授權。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「區分自製瓦片與官方地圖外部連結。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for licensed sources. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Tile display and bulk offline storage may need different rights. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Separate self-made tiles from official map links. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 區分自製瓦片與官方地圖外部連結。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Separate self-made tiles from official map links. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：可在瀏覽器看到就可無限抓取。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Browser visibility permits unlimited scraping. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「授權來源」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「區分自製瓦片與官方地圖外部連結。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for licensed sources; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
